resources.string: Cut apps off from the network. A blocked app can\'t send or receive anything through the tunnel. Changes apply to new connections right away and to open ones within 10 seconds.
Google Play Services, Google Services Framework and Play Store.

Google Play Services, Google Services Framework and the Play Store will have no network access.\n\nPush notifications in many apps, Play Store downloads and updates, Sign in with Google, Google Pay/Wallet, backup, Find My Device and fast location will stop working.
